canonical_data: Managed memory assets with ownership, versions, status, visibility, and bindings: layered chat memory, skills, wiki pages, and code graph
strengths: Team-scoped memory assets with ownership, bindings, and access levels
Proxy integration needs no plugin, hook, or MCP server from the agent
Layered refinement pipeline from conversations to core persona memory
Wiki link graph and code graph reach beyond chat history
weaknesses: PersonaMem improvement table states no sample, baseline harness, or statistics
Fully automated memory routing is still under iteration with manual binding
Code graph prioritizes public HTTPS repositories with private support refining
Three-service Docker deployment needs two sets of user-supplied model parameters
why_it_matters: The only team-scoped agent memory: a self-hosted hub and proxy where memory assets carry owners, bindings, and access control so agent teams inherit work instead of repeating it.
